report.title: SANS Ransomware Summit 2022, Can You Detect This?

timelineNote: The source is a detection companion synthesizing behaviors from multiple investigations, not one victim case. The eight-hour sequence is an operator-friendly lab ordering and is not asserted as source chronology.

phases.name: Office/ISO delivery and scheduled-task, BITS, web-shell, and RMM persistence detections
GetSystem, LSASS/NTDS/hive credential detections, Defender impairment, native discovery, AdFind, and IP scanning
PsExec/WMI/Cobalt movement, Rclone/WinSCP/FileZilla exfiltration, operator bloopers, and BYOT filenames
